headline: Cipher Digital has doubled the lease term at its Barber Lake data center to 20 years, lifting its contracted revenue above 9 billion dollars, a stock-analysis report says.
score_reason: Lowered from 5 to 4: coverage of the extension already existed on 9 Oct and the only readable account is a stock-analysis site, not the company.
importance_line: The longer lease gives Cipher a more predictable income from an AI customer, but the figures come from a stock-analysis site rather than the company's own statement, and the AI lab is not named.
summary: Simply Wall St, a stock-analysis site, reports that Cipher Digital, which has moved from bitcoin mining to building AI data centers, doubled the lease at its Barber Lake data center to 20 years and lifted its total contracted revenue above 9 billion dollars. The revised deal adds a 10-year commitment from an AI lab tied to the current tenant Fluidstack's lease, expected to bring in about 5.2 billion dollars over two decades; Data Center Dynamics reported the extension on 10 Oct, a day after this analysis.
notes: Pool item is Data Center Dynamics (blocked). Credit goes to Simply Wall St, whose text was read at Yahoo Finance. Valuation language ignored (no buy or sell advice).
